- `holdup-prototype-events.patch` (2026-09-26, runs 100-111; fourteen tracked files: the thirteen of the be-fast patch plus `network/SolidEventIntegrator`): the be-fast patch plus the event work of review 8.8. Apply it to a clean 9674bf1 **instead of** the other patches (it contains them; `git apply --check --reverse` on the patched tree and `--check` on the restored base verified 2026-09-26). Every default reproduces the be-fast patch (run 111: 399/399 at defaults, no init script). On top of be-fast it adds:
  - *Clog declared at an interval start is stopped like a declared one* (part of the `be` basis, no switch of its own): under `junction.integrator=be`, `SolidEventIntegrator.solve`'s interval-start closure pass stops the filter (`stopFilter`, `stoppedAtCapacity=true`) when the failure it finds is `FILTER_CLOGGED`, exactly as a FILTER_CLOGGED transition declared inside an interval does. Under backward Euler a 5 s interval is often one step, so the saturated inlet's landing is the interval's last step and the declaration always came from this pass, which blocked the filter both ways but never stopped it (run 100a).
  - *Rejection map in the backward-Euler exhaustion message* (part of `be`): the "Substep refinement exhausted" failure of `runBackwardEuler` appends `; reasons=<rejection map>`, as the attempt-cap failure already does (PumpRiseScalingTest, run 100).
  - `junction.boundaryReopen` (`-PboundaryReopen=on`, default `off`, read at every call): the backward-Euler controller refuses a converged step whose accepted modes hold a passive run closed (`boundaryClosed`; not a connection blocked both ways before the solve) although the step's own end states drive that run in a direction every link allows by more than `max(1 Pa, 1e-6 P)` (`PassiveStepSolver.reopenable`: the maximal run of closed passive connections through degree-two junctions no actuator touches, the run `closeDeadHeads` decides on; forward head on the first end's density, reverse on the second's; a junction end counts only while one of its connections is open in the step), and solves the same step again with that run exempt from the start-of-solve closures `closeDeadHeads` and `closeIllegalStarts` (`reopenNext`, consumed by the next non-rate solve). Each run is reopened at most once per attempted step (same t0 and step); the pass loop may still close it on a converged point. Counted as the rejection `Backward-Euler boundary reopened`, diagnostics key `be-reopen`, and in `PassiveIntervalSolver.BE_REOPENS`.
  - `junction.pumpReopenStart` (`-PpumpReopenStart=limit`, default `carry`, read at every call): a pump whose previous mode was CLOSED and which a pass runs on its head limit (the carry's `margin > band` offer) starts from `headLimitMassFlow` and the limit head instead of the closed point's zero flow and closed head. `Equations.headDensities` decides the pump row's column on that start point (run 107: from the closed head it chose the tank's bulk mixture, 879 kg/m3, instead of water, and every 5 s step ended 3423 Pa past the water-column shutoff).
  - Traces (print only): `-PbeTrace=true` adds `BEREJECT` (every thrown backward-Euler attempt: t, step, domain flag, message), `BEPRECHECK` (every interval-start solid closure: edge, reason, whether the filter was already stopped), `BEREOPEN` and `PUMPTRACE` (the pump carry decision with its margin and band, and every pass-loop pump mode change with flow, head, margin, band); `-PreopenTrace=true` (`junction.reopenTrace`) prints one `REOPENCHECK` line per closed run examined.

Never fails. `events.js` (`node events.js <xml> [cases] [every] [cadence]`: first slice, mode and reason changes per run) and `thresholds.js` (`node thresholds.js <xml> <case> <tankId> <P|T|m|liqVol> <thresholds> [reopen] [--rows]`: first slice end at or above each threshold, the overshoot there and the interpolated crossing) read it.
